name: Ring Biceps Curl
steps: Hold gymnastic rings at chest height with an underhand grip and walk your feet forward into a straight reclined lean.
Brace your core, keep your shoulders steady, and hold your upper arms raised slightly in front of your torso.
Curl your body smoothly upward by flexing your elbows until your hands come close to your temples.
Lower yourself slowly back to full elbow extension without letting your elbows drop toward your ribs.
tips: Keep your elbows lifted at shoulder height throughout each repetition so your biceps do the work instead of your lats.
Maintain a straight body line from head to heels without flexing at the hips.
